REFERENCE: Example Community - 123 Main St, Exampletown, CA
SUBJECT:
 Fire Sprinkler Inspection Quotation
Dear Pat,
 The Example Fire Sprinkler Company is providing you with our quotation to perform a Five
Year, Annual, & Quarterly Fire Sprinkler Inspection for the fire sprinkler system for the
above referenced project. Please note pricing below:
Five Year Inspection - $1,000 each riser (x2) to be done once every 5 years
Annual Inspection - $895 each riser (x2) to be done once every 1 year
Quarterly Inspection - $350 each riser (x2) to be done every 3 months; the fourth
quarterly will be an annual inspection.
Our quotation is based on verbal conversation & information provided. With the
following scope of work clarifications and exclusions:
This quote includes the following clarifications:
o
This is a one-time-only agreement for the 5year, annual, and quarterly inspection of
the fire sprinkler system(s) at the above referenced job location.
o
System(s) shall be inspected in strict accordance with NFPA #25 2013 CALIFORNIA
EDITION (as amended by CCR Title 19) for the inspection, testing & maintenance of
water based fire protection systems.
o
All systems meeting the requirements of NFPA #25 2013 California Edition (as
amended by CCR Title 19) shall be properly tagged, at the conclusion of each
inspection, with approved tags noting the date and technician performing the
inspection. Systems must be free from deficiencies prior to the placement of said
tag.
o
T.E.F.S.C. shall utilize the new Inspection Testing & Maintenance Reports (annex B) as
defined by NFPA #25 California Edition and as amended by CCR, Title 19. Inspection
reports shall be filled out and shall indicate the condition of the system, at the time of
the inspection and shall include all pertinent test data.
o
All inspections and tests shall be performed by properly trained and experienced fire
protection technicians.
4100 Example Ct Exampletown, CA 90001 Call (916) 555-0103 Fax (916) 555-0104 C-16 #900001
o
The recommendations that are made and/or observations during the inspection are
not to be considered an engineering review.
o
Customer shall provide complete and total uninterrupted access to all systems
during the inspection.
o
Customer shall place system in test with their monitoring company.
o
All units to be open and accessible for proper inspection
Exclusions:
1. Repairs and/or corrections of deficiencies
2. Integrity of the existing systems
3. Fire-watch (desired or required)
4. Re-inspection of items not corrected by The Example Fire Sprinkler Company (if applicable)
5. Plans or Permits
This proposal is valid for ten (10) days from the date of proposal.
Clarifications and exclusions of this proposal shall supersede any conflicting contract language.
The Example Fire Sprinkler Company terms and conditions, attached, shall apply.
Sincerely,
THE EXAMPLE FIRE SPRINKLER COMPANY
